definitions.cmg_application: Repeated scalar CMG apply_batch calls occur inside the Schur recurrence timer, along with vector updates/reductions; startup/restart work may be elsewhere. Neither recurrence nor solve is an isolated CMG application measurement.

definitions.limits: Descriptive within-unit spread, not new confidence/qualification claims. No separate graph/hierarchy/CMG-apply timers in bounded route. Distinct hosts do not prove independence; Mac blocks share one host.
definitions.native_call_s: Harness NATIVE_SECONDS around complete plugin invocation, excluding harness case-file parsing; this is the comparison helper timing.
definitions.polish_setup_plus_solve_s: Final residual absorption RSOLVER setup plus solve; fit.residual_absorb includes surrounding work.
definitions.projection_setup_s: RSOLVER initial absorption setup, including synchronous checkpoint construction; not isolated CMG graph/hierarchy.
definitions.projection_solve_s: RSOLVER initial absorption solve, including incumbent and restarted recurrence/operator/application work; not isolated CMG application.
definitions.stages: Recorded FEREG_PHASE durations; nested stages overlap and must not be added across levels. Schur invocations are indexed in log order; weak-low has three, other families two. All-invocation totals sum disjoint Schur records.
definitions.units: Linux: two mirrored blocks collapsed within each physical host; Mac: six accepted mirrored blocks on one desktop. Warmups excluded.
definitions.work_and_memory: setup_work is maximum reported per-action setup work (not sum, because later cached actions can repeat the same cumulative count); polish_setup_work is final action. Traced workspace peak differs from wait4 whole-process peak RSS.
